name: read_file
description: Read a file at an absolute or chat-project-relative path. Large files are truncated; use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to read later sections with line numbers.

start_line.description: First line to read (1-based). Omit to read from the beginning.

end_line.description: Last line to read (inclusive). Defaults to 200 lines from start_line.

name: write_file
description: Create or overwrite a file with the given contents.

name: edit_file
description: Replace exact text in one file. Pass path and edits: use one array entry for a single replacement or up to 100 for a batch. Put old_string and new_string inside each entry, never at the top level. Each search must be non-empty and unique at its step. Replacements are literal; all validate before writing. Input, replacements and result are each limited to 8 MiB. This is not multi-file rollback or protection from concurrent writers.

edits.description: Ordered literal replacements; all must succeed before the file is written.

name: glob
description: Find files matching a glob pattern within the chat project or an explicit directory.

path.description: Optional directory. Defaults to the chat project.

name: grep
description: Search file contents with a regular expression.

path.description: Optional file or directory to scope the search. Defaults to the chat project.

name: list_dir
description: List the entries of a directory.

name: bash
description: Run a command in the chat project and wait for it. Windows uses cmd.exe, not Bash or PowerShell; wrap PowerShell commands with powershell -NoProfile -Command. Unix uses /bin/sh. Subject to guardrails, risky commands require user approval. Killed after 120 seconds: for a dev server, a watcher, or anything that keeps running, use start_process instead of backgrounding it yourself.
